title: Scope staleness and volume directives to closeout-relevant commands
description: Emit doctor.recovery.required and operation-volume directives only from work close, sprint close, gate closeout, and session end. Mid-stream mutations stay silent about derived-state freshness. The rail is preserved: closing with a dirty workspace still blocks.
acceptanceCriteria: Directive compilation emits staleness/volume gaps only on closeout-relevant command paths
gate closeout still blocks on genuinely unhealthy state
